updates.content:
Title: Some users may be unable to launch the Microsoft Teams Windows desktop client

User impact: Users may be unable to launch the Microsoft Teams Windows desktop client.

More info: This issue specifically affects users who are running the latest Microsoft Edge WebView2 Canary version (v152.0.4190.0).

As a workaround, affected users can switch from Canary to the Stable version of Edge WebView2.

Current status: We’ve identified that a regression introduced in the latest Edge WebView2 Canary version is preventing the Microsoft Teams Windows desktop client from starting, resulting in impact. We’re working on a fix to restore normal client startup behavior.

Scope of impact: Users running the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Canary build and attempting to launch the Microsoft Teams Windows desktop client are impacted.

Root cause: A regression introduced in the latest Edge WebView2 Canary version is preventing the Microsoft Teams Windows desktop client from starting, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Thursday, August 6, 2026, at 3:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to launch the Microsoft Teams Windows desktop client

User impact: Users may be unable to launch the Microsoft Teams Windows desktop client.

Final status: The investigation is complete and we've determined the service is healthy. A service incident didn't actually occur. This communication will expire in 24 hours.

This is the final update for the event.
